programs.title: Noah: Chosen by God
programs.desc: The distant past.Due to the wickedness of Cain's descendants, the inhabitants of large cities, the world is falling into decline.Only representatives of the House of Set still carry out the will of the Creator.One night, former warrior and healer Noah (Russell Crowe) has a terrible dream.He sees it as a gigantic flood that destroys the world.Along with his wife Naameh (Jennifer Connelly) and three sons, he visits his grandfather Methuselah (Anthony Hopkins) to seek his advice.He discovers that his dream is actually a prediction of the great flood.Noah becomes aware that he has been chosen by the Creator to save the lives of innocents.With the help of stone giants called Guardians, he begins work on an ark that will be a shelter for various animal species.Years later, when the specter of disaster becomes more and more real, the huge ship is almost ready.Then the descendant of the first murderer, the self-proclaimed ruler Tubal-kain (Ray Winstone), demands a place in the ark for himself and his subjects.

programs.title: Neuilly-Poissy
programs.desc: Daniel (Max Boublil) is a successful entrepreneur.He successfully combines running a business with a successful family life.However, when financial irregularities are discovered in his company, he is forced to exchange a luxurious apartment in the city of Neuilly for a cell in the prison in Poissy.From one day to the next, he finds himself in a world whose rules he does not understand.Moreover, he is a Jew and now he will be hanging out with Muslims.However, thanks to his sense of humor and the ability to cope with difficult situations, Daniel tries to adapt to the new reality.

programs.title: L'amica geniale
programs.desc:
Elena Greco is an elderly woman who tries to solve the mystery of the disappearance of her friend - Raffaella Ceruullo, who was called Lila.The women met in their early youth - in 1950, when they attended primary school.The old woman recalls her early years.The action of the series takes place in dangerous and charming Naples and spans 60 years.The story of their relationship is unconventional, because although Lila was Elena's best friend and confidant, she was also her enemy.The series is an adaptation of the novel by Elena Ferrante
Elena is fed up with her boyfriend and decides to leave him.Meanwhile, Lila receives a declaration of love from her stubborn suitor - Marcello Solara.To gain her sympathy, the boy even abandoned his reprehensible manners.However, the girl once again rejects his advances - she doesn't want to have anything to do with this boy, who seems to her to be a brutal.Moreover, she would like to focus on something else - together with her brother Rino, she designs shoes based on a modern and original idea, which their father does not like.However, Marcello does not intend to give up.He manages to become friends with Rino and thus gains the trust of the Cerullo family.Finally, he asks the head of the family for his daughter's hand in marriage.Meanwhile, despite her sincere intentions, Elena cannot support her friend in this complicated situation.He has to leave.Lila understands this.

programs.title: The Munsters
programs.desc: Transylvania.Dr. Henry Augustus Wolfgang (Richard Brake) and his not very bright assistant Floop (Jorge Garcia) want to create the perfect man from the dead bodies of geniuses of the past century.By mistake, instead of the brain of a great scientist, they implant the organ of his twin brother, a bad comedian, into the creature they created.This is how Herman Potwornicki (Jeff Daniel Phillips) is created.When Wolfgang decides to show it to the world on TV, he is devastated.However, the uncouth, joking giant attracts the attention of the unmarried and undead Lily (Sheri Moon), who is fed up with unsuccessful dates.The girl finds Herman and they quickly become a couple.The future son-in-law, although he gained fame and won Lily's heart, does not like her father, a vampire and a refined count (Daniel Roebuck).However, the lovers get married.Due to the intrigues of the count's cunning ex-wife, Zoya Krupp (Catherine Schell) and her assistant, the werewolf Lester (Tomas Boykin), they lose their palace and fortune.They decide to go to America, where Herman intends to conquer Hollywood.They start a new life in a ruined house in the suburbs.A colorful production referring to the series from the 1960s. Director Rob Zombie is his big fan.

programs.title: The Pig Who Cried Werewolf
programs.desc: A bad wolf lives next to three little pigs, Heimlich, Dieter and Chef.The first of them discovers that under the influence of the moon he transforms into a woman who is obsessed with catching pigs.

programs.title: The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies
programs.desc: Thorin Oakenshield, the hobbit Bilbo and their companions recover the treasure of Erebor, which was guarded by Smaug.The leader of a company of dwarves cannot resist wealth.He sacrifices friendship and honor to gloat over him.To make matters worse, armies of elves and humans appear at the Lonely Mountain, intending to take over some of the dwarves' gold as compensation for the losses caused by the dragon.For years, the beast ravaged the area and destroyed their settlements.Proud Thorin does not intend to give in to the demands of the newcomers.To resolve conflicts, Bilbo secretly gives the elves the archjewel.They use the treasure as an argument in negotiations with Thorin, and the hobbit becomes a traitor to the dwarves.While representatives of different races are arguing with each other and trying to force concessions, the army of their common enemy is approaching the dwarves' headquarters.In the face of danger, the conflicting parties must unite.

programs.title: Minecraft
programs.desc: Garrett (Jason Momoa), Henry (Sebastian Hansen), Natalie (Emma Myers) and Dawn (Danielle Brooks) constantly struggle with problems.The lives of these four change when a magical portal pulls them into a strange land full of cubes.The Overworld turns out to be a place where everything is possible thanks to imagination, which, however, is sometimes difficult to control.Once there, Garrett, Henry, Natalie and Dawn meet Steve (Jack Black), who was trapped on this side of the portal many years earlier.Together with him, they decide to defend the unusual land from evil creatures called piglins.For them to succeed, they will have to show courage and discover qualities that will make it easier for them to find their place in the real world later.A hit production for the whole family, inspired by the popular game.

programs.title: Red One
programs.desc: The third joint film of Jake Kasdan and Dwayne Johnson, after two installments of the new version of "Jumanji".The head of North Pole security and a bounty hunter search for the missing Santa Claus.

programs.title: Insecure
programs.desc: Issa Dee (Issa Rae), a twenty-something African American woman, lives in Los Angeles.Although she experiences many humiliations, she tries to fight against her chronic lack of self-confidence and her own weaknesses.The lack of money and work problems don't help her at all.Her best friend is Molly (Yvonne Orji), a self-centered lawyer.The series tells the story of the lives of contemporary black women living in the United States.Its originator and producer is the main actress, Issa Rae (First).The artist gained popularity thanks to the website The Misadventures Of Awkward Black Girl and her YouTube channel - so far she has collected over 200,000 likes.followers and 20 million plays.Yvonne Orji (Love That Girl!), Jay Ellis (The Rules of the Game) and Lisa Joyce (It's Never Too Late) will also appear on screen.Critics compare the series to the cult HBO production titled "Girls".

programs.title: The Last of Us
programs.desc:
Twenty years have passed since the destruction of civilization.Joel Miller (Pedro Pascal) is a battle-hardened survivor.One day, a man is hired to smuggle 14-year-old Ellie (Bella Ramsey) out of the oppressive quarantine zone.What begins as a simple assignment soon becomes a dangerous and heartbreaking journey across the old United States.During this expedition, they both begin to understand that they can only rely on each other to survive.Based on the popular video game of the same title
Joel and Ellie wander through a desolate forest area.The man finds it difficult to come to terms with Tess's death.He still doesn't accept the teenager's company.Together they reach the empty building where Joel hid supplies years ago.The next destination of their trip is Bill and Frank's fortress.The year 2003. Survivalist Bill is hiding in his house.When the army deports all the inhabitants of his town, they surround the area with barbed wire, install traps for the infected and stockpile supplies.Four years later, a hungry wanderer, Frank, reaches him.Since the man is not infected, it is agreed to feed him.Ultimately, Frank stays in Bill's house for many years.The two start working with smugglers Tess and Joel.

programs.title: Georgie \u0026 Mandy'S First Marriage 2
programs.desc: Young married couple Georgie and Mandy are raising their daughter, learning everyday life in their new role as parents.Each day brings new challenges and fatigue that puts their relationship to the test.
